scenes.title: Opening Invocation
scenes.narration: महादेव... एक ऐसा नाम, जिसे सुनते ही मन में एक साथ कई भाव जाग उठते हैं।
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Establish the sacred name "Mahadev" and the spiritual theme of the story; introduce the devotee's emotional connection through the power of the name alone, without visual representation.
scenes.motion: soft light expanding from center, cosmic energy ripple
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: awakening dissolves into dual emotional qualities

shots.semantic_meaning: the sacred name Mahadev is invoked chanted
shots.dramatic_purpose: establish the divine theme and spiritual atmosphere
shots.action: consciousness awakening to the divine name
shots.motion: soft light expanding from center, cosmic energy ripple

scenes.title: Dual Emotions: Peace and Fear
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Introduce the dual emotional qualities of peace (shanti) and fear (bhaya) that the divine name evokes in the devotee's heart, establishing the full range of spiritual experience.
scenes.motion: light dividing into two contrasting qualities, shifting colors
scenes.lighting: contrasting light and shadow, dual palette
scenes.continuity_from_previous_scene: same cosmic expanse, light evolving from scene 1
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: peace and fear emerge as distinct qualities

shots.semantic_meaning: peace is one of the emotions evoked by the name Mahadev
shots.dramatic_purpose: establish the emotional range of the divine experience

scenes.title: Compassion and Infinite Power
scenes.narration: करुणा भी... और अनंत शक्ति का एहसास भी।
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Introduce compassion (karuna) and the feeling of infinite power (ananta shakti), expanding the devotee's experience of the divine.
scenes.action: compassion and power surfacing in consciousness
scenes.motion: warm light growing in intensity, expanding presence
scenes.continuity_from_previous_scene: same cosmic space, emotional quality deepening
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: compassion and power stabilize into focus

shots.semantic_meaning: compassion is one of the emotions evoked
shots.dramatic_purpose: expand the emotional range of the divine experience
shots.motion: warm light growing in intensity, expanding presence

scenes.title: Divine Status: Of All Gods
scenes.narration: वे देवों के देव हैं... महादेव हैं।
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Declare Shiva as "of all gods" (devon ke dev) and as "Mahadev" himself, establishing the central divinity of the story through pure declaration rather than visual form.
scenes.motion: focused light sharpening, center of attention
scenes.continuity_from_previous_scene: same cosmic space, emotional quality deepening
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: divine status confirmed, moving to nature of existence

shots.semantic_meaning: Shiva is declared the god of all gods
shots.dramatic_purpose: establish the central divinity of the story
shots.motion: focused light sharpening, center of attention

scenes.title: No Beginning, No End
scenes.narration: न उनका कोई आदि दिखाई देता है... न कोई अंत।
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Convey the infinite nature of Shiva - having no beginning and no end - through the negation of origin and conclusion, establishing the eternal quality of the divine.
scenes.motion: cyclic light pattern, endless loop of illumination
scenes.continuity_from_previous_scene: same cosmic space, moving from declaration to essence
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: eternal nature leads to pre-creation state

shots.lyric_segment: न उनका कोई आदि दिखाई देता है...
shots.dramatic_purpose: establish the eternal, beginningless nature of the divine
shots.motion: cyclic light pattern, endless loop of illumination

scenes.title: Before Creation and Time
scenes.narration: जब सृष्टि का अस्तित्व भी नहीं था... जब समय ने चलना शुरू नहीं किया था...
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Depict the state before creation and before time began, using the grounded action of time's non-walk to anchor the abstract concept of pre-existence.
scenes.motion: stillness with subtle time indication, no movement
scenes.continuity_from_previous_scene: same timeless void, transition from eternal nature
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: time does not yet walk, creating anticipation

shots.lyric_segment: जब सृष्टि का अस्तित्व भी नहीं था...
shots.semantic_meaning: no existence of creation before beginning
shots.dramatic_purpose: depict the state before creation and before time
shots.motion: stillness with subtle time indication, no movement

scenes.title: Element Present Was Shiva
scenes.narration: तब भी जो तत्व विद्यमान था— वही शिव था।
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Declare that the element present in the pre-creation state was Shiva himself, establishing the divine identity at the cosmic origin point and transitioning from abstract to concrete reference.
scenes.continuity_from_previous_scene: same void, time suspending, now divine identity revealed
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: Shiva identified, creation begins its end

shots.lyric_segment: तब भी जो तत्व विद्यमान था—
shots.semantic_meaning: the element present in pre-creation was Shiva
shots.dramatic_purpose: declare the divine identity at the cosmic origin

scenes.title: Creation's End: Elements Merge
scenes.narration: और जब एक दिन यह संपूर्ण सृष्टि अपने अंतिम क्षण में प्रवेश करेगी... जब आकाश, पृथ्वी, अग्नि, जल और वायु अपने मूल में विलीन हो जाएंगे...
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Depict the end of creation where all elements (sky, earth, fire, water, wind) merge back into their source, serving as the cosmic dissolution that sets up the return to the divine.
scenes.motion: each element dissolving into source light, collapsing together
scenes.continuity_from_previous_scene: same cosmic origin, divine presence fading into merge
scenes.transition_to_next_scene: elements merge, returning to the eternal source

shots.lyric_segment: और जब एक दिन यह संपूर्ण सृष्टि अपने अंतिम क्षण में प्रवेश करेगी...
shots.semantic_meaning: the entire creation enters its final moment
shots.dramatic_purpose: depict the end of creation where all elements merge
shots.motion: each element dissolving into source light, collapsing together
